text:
nora (People Ops): FYI folks 1 10 1  New cycle orientation + required forms posted. Self-assessments open today, due Tue Sep 22 23:59 PT. Manager calibration window: Sep 23-27. Please read the "Calibration Orientation" section in the guide: https://redwood.app/docs/perf-2026/orientation and use the new Manager Concurrency + Evidence Locker form.

kevin (Eng Manager): Quick double-check: what's the "Manager Concurrency" piece? haven't seen that before.

nora (People Ops): Short: it's a one-line confirmation managers sign that they reviewed scoring normalization notes and that no more than 2 ratings were adjusted >1 band without documented evidence. It's to capture concurrence across raters. Not punitive, just audit trail.

mai (IC): New "Evidence Locker" form 1 what lives there vs manager comments?

nora (People Ops): Evidence Locker = links to dashboards, PRs, release notes, or short screenshots that support the rating. Managers must upload at least one item per rating change. This helps calibration reviewers validate claims quickly. Manager comments remain the narrative for the IC.

adrian (SRE): Is there a normalization matrix this cycle? I remember talk about z-scores last time.

nora (People Ops): We have an optional normalization worksheet this cycle. It's a simple z-score guidance sheet to help teams compare across different signal scales (e.g., uptime %, tickets closed). Not required, but recommended for cross-team roles where raw metrics vary a lot.

kevin (Eng Manager): Can we run a brief 60-min "calibration orientation" for new managers? timezone-friendly?

srini (Director): I'll host a 60-min orientation Thu Sep 25 16:00-17:00 PT (recorded). We'll cover the new forms, Evidence Locker expectations, and common edge-cases. If that time doesn't work, DM me and we'll add an earlier slot.

zoe (Recruiter): HiringOps asks: can managers flag "Promotion Signal" items in a structured way so we can triage quickly?

nora (People Ops): Yes 1 added a structured Promotion Signal checklist in the manager form (checkboxes + 1 short evidence link). Keep it 1-2 bullets. Recruiters will get an export.

kevin (Eng Manager): Extension policy: same as before? someone out for surgery.

nora (People Ops): Standard extension: up to 3 business days for short absences via the extension form. For medical or accommodations >3 days submit an Exceptions request; HR will review and can approve extended windows. Link: https://redwood.app/forms/perf-exception.

mai (IC): Peer feedback: can it be anonymous this cycle? folks worry about sensitive feedback.

nora (People Ops): Peer feedback remains opt-in and non-anonymous by default. Teams can run a separate anonymized survey for development coaching, but anonymized feedback can't be the primary evidence for calibration decisions. If you choose anonymized, include at least one manager-verified evidence item in the Evidence Locker.

adrian (SRE): How do we surface calibration outcomes? automated email again? last time some people missed them.

nora (People Ops): Yes, peopleops-bot will send an autogenerated email with final rating + manager comments within 72 business hours of submission. Also managers should confirm direct reports received it; peopleops-bot will post a confirmation in #people-ops when bulk sends complete.

kevin (Eng Manager): Any change to appeals or recalibration?

nora (People Ops): Recalibration requests still go through the Recalibration form within 3 business days. This cycle note: include Evidence Locker links and the scoring CSV; those speed triage. If escalated, directors will convene an ad-hoc calibration session. IC appeals have the standard HR path.

zoe (Recruiter): Ops ask: can we require the "Onboarding & Ramp" field for hires <75 days? we want consistent ramp notes.

nora (People Ops): Set to required for <75 days this cycle. Keep it 1-3 bullets: current focus, checkpoints, suggested mentor.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Calibration orientation session in 3 days" will post to #people-ops and to managers.

kevin (Eng Manager): One more operational ask: is there a filename rule for Evidence Locker uploads? want to avoid messy exports.

nora (People Ops): Yes - use the template: teamname_evidence_YYYYMMDD.ext (e.g., infra_evidence_20260923.pdf). The Evidence Locker form will reject nonconforming names to keep exports clean.

mai (IC): Anything new on auditability or data retention?

nora (People Ops): Audit note: all Evidence Locker items are retained for 24 months and taggable by "audit"; calibration notes must include a short audit tag whenever a rating is changed post-submission. That helps compliance teams.

kevin (Eng Manager): Filed an extension for one engineer. Thanks for the clarity on Evidence Locker.

nora (People Ops): Got it - I'll fast-track review and reply by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone 1 ping me or DM for edge cases.
